a.description: array-like, with ``StringDType``, ``bytes_``, or ``str_`` dtype Input array

sep.description: array-like, with ``StringDType``, ``bytes_``, or ``str_`` dtype Separator to split each string element in ``a``.

output.description: ------- 3-tuple: - array with ``StringDType``, ``bytes_`` or ``str_`` dtype with the part before the separator - array with ``StringDType``, ``bytes_`` or ``str_`` dtype with the separator - array with ``StringDType``, ``bytes_`` or ``str_`` dtype with the part after the separator

constraints: Input array and separator must have the same dtype
